answer.says: Sunil, bring me another cup and one of those samosas. The heat has dried the thought out of my head, and my stomach is making a noise that distracts from the dialectic of hunger.
answer.thought: I am here to find a pen or ink, but my body is demanding fuel first. The distinction between the needs of the spirit and the needs of the flesh is a pedantic one when the latter is roaring; I must eat to think. The market is still open, a system of needs that ignores the hour.
